main_issue: How to get Agent D's half-done section finished by Thursday's pitch given D's bereavement (who covers it, or whether D finishes it tonight).

A-B.evidence: A asks someone to take over D's section (T3) and B refuses (T4); B then questions D working tonight (T10) while A welcomes it (T9). They never address each other and are not clearly opposed.

A-C.evidence: A asks for someone to get up to speed (T3); C declines (T5). C says nothing further and never addresses A.

A-D.evidence: D first offers to finish tomorrow night (T6); A says that's too late (T7); D agrees to finish tonight (T8) and A thanks D (T9).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take on D's section (T4, T5). Neither addresses the other, and C stays silent after that.

B-D.evidence: B asks D 'are you sure? You should be with your family tonight' (T10); D says they'll work late after (T12); B replies 'Okay' (T13) and D thanks B (T14). B concedes without endorsing the plan.

C-D.evidence: C declines to take the section (T5) and D says 'I understand' (T6), but there is no further interaction between them.
